name: Tag Properties
changes: Include core tags and a second tag property now show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. The first tag property stays free.
tip: Select "Copy bases filter" to use the current tag selection in the advanced filter editor of a base.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Tag Properties is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to browse your notes by topic.
